title: Solution Architect
description:
osition: Solution Architect
 Experience: 12+ years
 Location: Ahmedabad / Hyderabad
 Time Zone/Shift: Starts at 12:30 PM IST
 
 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong experience in designing and architecting large-scale e-commerce applications.
 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to define and drive the technical architecture of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, QA, and business teams to design scalable, secure, highly available, and maintainable solutions.
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Java/Spring Boot, React, microservices, APIs, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , along with a solid understanding of modern e-commerce architecture.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Define and maintain the end-to-end architecture for e-commerce applications across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
 Design scalable and highly available solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and React .
 Define frontend architecture and best practices using React, TypeScript, state management, and reusable components .
 Design cloud-native solutions on GCP , considering scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost optimization.
 Work with engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 Define architecture standards, design patterns, coding standards, and technology guidelines.
 Review technical designs, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches.
 Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability or performance issues.
 Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers, leads, and engineering teams.
 Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, infrastructure, observability, monitoring, and deployment strategies.
 Ensure solutions follow security, compliance, and enterprise architecture standards.
 Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
 Support troubleshooting of complex production issues and provide long-term architectural solutions.
 
 Technical Skills 
 Backend 
 Java 11/17+
 Spring Boot / Spring Framework
 Microservices architecture
 REST APIs
 Event-driven architecture
 Kafka or similar messaging platforms
 Distributed systems and caching
 Frontend 
 React
 TypeScript / JavaScript
 React-based application architecture
 State management
 Responsive and reusable UI architecture
 Frontend performance optimization
 Cloud GCP 
 Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform 
 GKE / Kubernetes
 Cloud Run
 Cloud Functions
 API Gateway / Apigee
 Pub/Sub
 Cloud SQL / Spanner
 Cloud Storage
 IAM and security
 Cloud Load Balancing
 Monitoring and Logging
 VPC and networking
 Cloud-native architecture and cost optimization
 DevOps & Engineering 
 GitHub / Git
 CI/CD
 Docker
 Kubernetes
 Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
 Automated testing
 Observability and application monitoring
 E-commerce Experience
 Strong experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: 
 Product catalog
 Search
 Pricing and promotions
 Cart and checkout
 Order management
 Payment integrations
 Inventory
 Customer/account management
 Personalization
 Store and e-commerce integrations
 Third-party integrations
 High-volume transactional systems
 Architecture & Leadership 
 Strong understanding of domain-driven design (DDD) and microservices.
 Experience designing high-volume, low-latency distributed systems .
 Strong understanding of API design and integration patterns.
 Experience with scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
 Ability to make architecture decisions considering performance, maintainability, security, and cost .
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to work with senior engineering and business stakeholders and clearly communicate complex technical concepts.
 Experience mentoring technical leads and senior engineers.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 12+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in an Architect/Senior Architect role .
 Experience architecting large-scale e-commerce platforms .
 Strong combination of Java + React + GCP experience.
 GCP certification is a plus.
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 Experience working with distributed/global engineering teams.
 
 What We Are Looking For 
 The ideal candidate is not just an architecture/documentation person. We are looking for someone who can work closely with engineering teams, challenge technical decisions, review implementation, troubleshoot complex problems, and drive the architecture from design through production .
 
 Core Technology Stack: 
 React | TypeScript | Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST | Kafka/Pub/Sub | GCP | Kubernetes | Docker | GitHub | CI/CD

Key Skills: Java,GCP,React.js,Microservices,Spring Boot,Boot,Bootstrap,Architecture

title: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Solution Architect
description:
Responsibilities: 
 10+ years of experience delivering Microsoft Dynamics solutions, including significant expertise with Dynamics 365 FSCM. Proven success leading full-lifecycle enterprise Dynamics 365 implementations from strategy through deployment. Deep expertise designing and implementing solutions for manufacturing, industrial products, wholesale distribution, supply chain, and inventory-driven organizations. Strong functional knowledge across Finance, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Warehouse Management. Experience conducting solution design sessions, fit-gap analysis, business process transformation, and architecture governance. Expertise in data migration, data quality, data mapping, and transformation strategies using tools such as Azure Data Factory and KingswaySoft. Experience integrating Dynamics 365 with external systems using REST APIs, OData, Azure Logic Apps, middleware platforms, and Azure services. Strong understanding of security, governance, compliance, and enterprise architecture best practices. Experience with Azure DevOps, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), source control, and CI/CD practices. Familiarity with Power Platform, including Power BI and Power Automate. Working knowledge of Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) and Field Service solutions. Demonstrated ability to engage executive stakeholders and influence strategic technology decisions. Experience working with global delivery teams and collaborating with North American clients and stakeholders. Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation, and consulting skills. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Microsoft certifications such as MB-700, MB-330, MB-310, MB-500, etc. Experience leading global, multi-country, or multi-entity Dynamics 365 implementations. Consulting experience with Microsoft partners, systems integrators, or enterprise consulting organizations. Experience extending Dynamics 365 solutions using Azure services, Power Platform, and modern Microsoft technologies. Knowledge of enterprise reporting, analytics, Power BI, and data architecture best practices. 
 Why Join Quisitive? 
 Influence technology strategy and business outcomes at the executive level. Collaborate with a global team of Microsoft experts across Dynamics 365, Azure, Data, Security, and AI practices. Gain exposure to the latest Microsoft technologies, including Power Platform, Fabric, Azure, and AI-driven business solutions. Grow your career in a culture that values innovation, learning, collaboration, and customer success.

Key Skills: Dynamics 365,Dynamics 365 FSCM,Dynamics 365 F&O,MS Dynamics CRM,Inventory Management,Supply Chain Management,Manufacturing,Microsoft
